title: Sloth reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tree branch -->
  <rect x='0' y='72' width='100' height='10' rx='4' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='0' y='72' width='100' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A0704A'/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#B8A07A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#D4C4A8'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#B8A07A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#D4C4A8'/>

  <!-- Face mask (light) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#EDE0CC'/>

  <!-- Eye patches (dark brown) -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='36' rx='4.5' ry='4' fill='#6B4E2E'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='36' rx='4.5' ry='4' fill='#6B4E2E'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='36' r='2' fill='#1A1A1A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='36' r='2' fill='#1A1A1A'/>
  <circle cx='44.7' cy='35.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56.7' cy='35.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#4A3520'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M46 45 Q50 48 54 45' stroke='#4A3520' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='30' r='4' fill='#B8A07A'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='30' r='2' fill='#D4C4A8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='30' r='4' fill='#B8A07A'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='30' r='2' fill='#D4C4A8'/>

  <!-- Arms holding book -->
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d='M32 50 Q26 56 30 62' stroke='#A8906A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M68 50 Q74 56 70 62' stroke='#A8906A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Book -->
  <!-- Left page -->
  <path d='M30 58 L48 56 L48 72 L30 74 Z' fill='#E8E0D0'/>
  <!-- Right page -->
  <path d='M52 56 L70 58 L70 74 L52 72 Z' fill='#F5EEE0'/>
  <!-- Spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='56' x2='50' y2='72' stroke='#C0392B' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Cover edges -->
  <path d='M28 57 L48 55 L48 73 L28 75 Z' fill='none' stroke='#8B2E22' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M52 55 L72 57 L72 75 L52 73 Z' fill='none' stroke='#8B2E22' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Text lines on pages -->
  <line x1='33' y1='62' x2='45' y2='61' stroke='#9B8B70' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='66' x2='45' y2='65' stroke='#9B8B70' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='70' x2='43' y2='69' stroke='#9B8B70' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='61' x2='67' y2='62' stroke='#9B8B70' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='65' x2='67' y2='66' stroke='#9B8B70' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='69' x2='65' y2='70' stroke='#9B8B70' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Hands/claws on book -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='60' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#C4A882'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='60' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#C4A882'/>

  <!-- Feet/legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='76' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#B8A07A'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='76' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#B8A07A'/>

  <!-- Branch detail -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='77' rx='8' ry='3' fill='#7A5232'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='77' rx='6' ry='2.5' fill='#7A5232'/>
</svg>
